question.reasoning: The description says the Safe is buying 1,000 USDC on Uniswap for at most 1 ETH, which implies the Safe itself will receive the purchased USDC. The trace shows the Safe spends ~0.3546 ETH via Uniswap, but the resulting 1,000 USDC is sent to an external address (0x2C81904f370e7f6490aEa328CA847AEFdc3853D3) rather than back to the Safe (0x5afe5afE5afE5afE5afE5aFe5aFe5Afe5Afe5AfE).
question.question: Why does this swap send the purchased 1,000 USDC to 0x2C81904f370e7f6490aEa328CA847AEFdc3853D3 instead of the Safe?
